Structures A and B of the same molecule share atom order and one Cartesian frame (angstrom). The table gives the total PBE0+MBD force on every atom at B (eV/angstrom), with F_i = −∂E/∂r_i. Along the straight path r_i(λ) = r_i(B) + λ[r_i(A) − r_i(B)], which starts at B and moves toward A, what is dE/dλ at λ = 0 (that is, at B), in eV? Do not realign, mass-weight or normalize the displacement.

选项：
A. -5.0423 eV
B. -0.6163 eV
C. 5.4891 eV
D. 9.5279 eV

附件：A.xyz、B.xyz、forces_B.txt（均为本题完整输入）。范围：QM7-X 分子 7040：A 为 DFTB3+MBD 优化结构，B 为配对位移结构 c1-d2；B 处 PBE0+MBD 总力；路径从 B 指向 A，只问 λ=0（即 B 处）方向导数。 只回答一个字母 A、B、C 或 D。
